overall_goal: Prepare, chop, and wash shredded lettuce for the wraps.

goals.description: Inspect the romaine lettuce and retrieve a sieve.
goals.rationale: The person inspects the lettuce leaves and retrieves a sieve from the drawer to prepare for washing.

goals.description: Wash the whole head of romaine lettuce.
goals.rationale: The person takes the whole head of lettuce to the sink and washes it under the tap before cutting.

goals.description: Remove the core and make longitudinal cuts on the lettuce.
goals.rationale: The person removes the core of the lettuce and makes several longitudinal cuts along the head.

goals.description: Slice the lettuce crosswise to shred it and gather the pieces.
goals.rationale: The person slices across the longitudinal cuts to create shredded lettuce and gathers the pieces into a pile.

goals.description: Transfer the shredded lettuce into the sieve.
goals.rationale: The person moves the chopping board and transfers the pile of shredded lettuce into the sieve.

goals.description: Wash the shredded lettuce in the sieve under running water.
goals.rationale: The person washes the shredded lettuce in the sieve under the tap to ensure it is thoroughly clean.
